description: This file defines the SectionRenderer class responsible for rendering a 'Section' object into RTF format within the MigraDoc document processing library. It includes methods for rendering section properties, headers, footers, and child elements of the section.

classes.name: SectionRenderer
classes.description: Class to render a Section object into RTF format within the document layout.

methods.name: Render
methods.description: Main method that performs the rendering of a Section, including its properties, headers, footers, and child elements.
